name: What are common signs of storm damage to look for on my roof?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of storm damage to look for on my roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of storm damage include missing, cracked, or bruised shingles; dents on gutters, downspouts, or vents; granules accumulating in gutters; and leaks or water spots on interior ceilings. After a severe storm, even if you don't immediately see obvious damage, it's wise to visually inspect your roof from the ground or have a professional conduct an evaluation. Hail damage, for example, might not be visible from the ground but can significantly shorten your roof's lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for missing/cracked shingles, dents on gutters, granules in gutters, or interior leaks after a storm. Professional evaluation is recommended.
